jobs.title: Director of Financial Planning and Analysis
jobs.description:
About Allied

Allied is a leading owner-operator of distinctive urban workspace in Canada’s major cities. Our work is grounded in a clear purpose: to provide knowledge-based organizations with distinctive urban environments that support creativity, connectivity and human wellness.

Our vision is more expansive. We seek to make a continuous contribution to cities and culture that elevates and inspires the humanity in all of us. This vision informs how we operate, how we design and how we lead.

Real estate, for us, is not a passive investment. It is a profoundly human endeavour, one that must promote wellness, sustainability, diversity and creativity—today and for generations to come.

Allied is also a place to build a career of consequence. If you are looking for work that is thoughtful, tangible and enduring—work that contributes meaningfully to cities and the people who inhabit them—you will find purpose here.

For more information on Allied’s approach to city-building, visit our Insights page.

Purpose

Lead Allied’s financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis and management reporting activities.
As Director, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), you will lead budgeting and forecasting processes, develop long-term financial plans and provide analysis of financial and operating performance across Allied’s portfolio and corporate functions.

As a key member of the Finance leadership team, you will serve as a strategic business partner to senior leaders and help strengthen financial planning, analytical capabilities and financial discipline across the organization. This role is well suited to a collaborative and forward-looking finance leader with strong financial modelling and analytical capabilities and a commitment to developing people and building high-performing teams.

Responsibilities

Financial Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting
Lead budgeting and forecasting processes across the organization, establishing timelines, assumptions and requirements in partnership with key stakeholders.
Develop and own consolidated financial forecasts and multi-year financial plans.
Establish and track key performance indicators related to occupancy, leasing, operating performance, capital expenditures, financing and other business drivers.
Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses to assess the financial implications of changing business and market conditions.
Continuously enhance planning and forecasting processes to improve accuracy, efficiency and business insight.

Performance Analysis and Management Reporting
Lead the preparation of monthly and quarterly management reporting for senior leadership.
Analyze actual financial performance relative to budget, forecast and prior periods, identifying key drivers of variances.
Analyze key performance indicators, including funds from operations (FFO), adjusted funds from operations (AFFO) and related financial and operating metrics.
Identify emerging trends, risks and opportunities and communicate their potential financial impact to senior leadership.
Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards and other reporting tools that provide clear visibility into organizational performance.
Lead the development of financial and performance reporting for the Board of Trustees and its committees.

Long-Term Financial Planning and Strategic Analysis
Lead the development and maintenance of Allied’s long-term financial model.
Assess the impact of changes in occupancy, leasing activity, rental rates, interest rates, capital expenditures, development activity and other key business assumptions.
Model the financial implications of potential acquisitions, dispositions, developments and other strategic initiatives in partnership with Investments and other business functions.
Evaluate alternative financial scenarios and provide recommendations to support strategic planning and capital allocation decisions.
Provide financial analysis and recommendations to the Chief Financial Officer and senior leadership to support business and strategic decisions.
Assess the impact of business plans and strategic initiatives on liquidity, leverage, FFO, AFFO and other key financial measures.

Capital Planning
Coordinate Allied’s annual and long-term capital planning processes.
Consolidate forecasts for property capital expenditures, leasing capital, tenant improvements and development expenditures.
Monitor capital spending against approved plans and identify material variances, risks and emerging requirements.
Integrate capital plans into corporate forecasts and long-term financial models.
Provide analysis of the impact of capital investments on financial performance, liquidity and key REIT metrics.

FP&A Systems, Data and Continuous Improvement
Lead the development and enhancement of financial planning, forecasting and management reporting tools and processes.
Identify opportunities to automate and streamline financial planning and reporting activities.
Establish consistent financial models, reporting methodologies and performance measures across the organization.
Promote effective use of financial and operational data to improve business insight and decision-making.
Partner with Corporate Accounting and technology teams to support the effective integration of financial systems, data and reporting tools.
Champion continuous improvement and best practices across the FP&A function.

Leadership and Team Development
Lead, mentor and develop the FP&A team, fostering strong analytical, financial and business-partnering capabilities.
Establish clear priorities and expectations and promote a high standard of quality, accountability and collaboration.
Build strong relationships across Finance and the broader organization.
Develop organizational capability through coaching, knowledge sharing and succession planning.
Foster a culture of curiosity, continuous improvement and informed decision-making.

Qualifications

CPA designation required.
7+ years of progressive experience in accounting and finance within commercial real estate or property accounting.
Strong technical accounting and financial reporting experience, including full-cycle accounting processes.
Experience leading and developing high-performing teams.
Experience supporting budgeting and reforecasting processes in partnership with FP&A and operational teams.
Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and levels of the organization.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills, with a high level of attention to detail.
Experience with Yardi or similar property accounting systems is considered an asset.

Total Rewards and the Employee Experience

At Allied, total rewards are designed with the same perspective that shapes our operations. They are intended to support sustained contribution, creativity and a genuine sense of ownership in the work we do.

In practice, this includes:

Shared financial success and an ownership mindset

Eligible employees participate in performance-based bonus programs and a retirement savings program, with the option to invest in traditional funds or Allied units. This approach aligns individual effort with Allied’s long-term performance and reinforces a sense of ownership at every level of the organization.

Intentional presence and time off

In addition to vacation, employees receive six personal days and half-days before statutory holidays. Allied supports flexibility while maintaining a strong, in-person culture. This reflects how we collaborate most effectively and how we operate as a business.

Health, wellbeing and support

Comprehensive, company-paid health benefits include vision and dental coverage, along with a healthcare spending account. An employee assistance program is available to provide confidential support when it is needed.

Growth through leadership and exposure

Allied believes in leadership at every level. Employees are encouraged to contribute beyond the boundaries of their role, collaborate across disciplines and develop a broad understanding of the business. For those drawn to real estate, this includes uncommon exposure to how buildings, organizations and cities evolve through hands-on experience and shared responsibility.

Professional development grounded in practice

Learning at Allied is both formal and experiential. Ongoing professional development and a mentorship program support growth through structured learning and day-to-day engagement with experienced colleagues across the organization.

Purpose and connection beyond work

Each year, employees are provided with a paid volunteer day to contribute time and effort to a cause that is personally meaningful to them, reflecting our belief that contribution extends beyond the workplace.

If you are motivated by the role real estate plays in shaping cities and culture, and want your work to contribute to that effort, we encourage you to apply.

More insight into life at Allied, including our ESG and EDI initiatives, can be found in our annual ESG report.

Additional Information

We value human connection and experience. While Allied uses technology, including AI-enabled tools, to support administrative efficiency, all screening, assessment and hiring decisions are made by people.

We are committed to hiring the most qualified candidates with a dedication towards supporting diversity, equity and inclusion across our organization. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, origin, sexual orientation, disability and socioeconomic background. Diverse perspectives strengthen our organization and help us deliver better outcomes for our tenants, partners and communities. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

We strive to provide an accessible recruitment experience and welcome reasonable accommodation requests at any stage of the recruitment process. Please reach out to talent@alliedreit.com if support is needed.

We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Director of Finance | Hotel PUR, Quebec, A Tribute Portfolio Hotel
jobs.description:
Discover Hotel PUR, Quebec, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, where bold design, local spirit and modern hospitality come together in the heart of Quebec City’s vibrant Saint-Roch district. With striking city views, distinctive spaces, locally inspired dining, a heated indoor pool and a neighborhood filled with art, culture, boutiques and celebrated restaurants, Hotel PUR offers guests an experience that is anything but ordinary. For hospitality professionals, it’s an opportunity to be part of a dynamic, design-forward property where the energy of Quebec City is woven into every guest experience.

The Director of Finance is responsible for providing ethical and consistent leadership in the financial area of the hotel by supplying management with guidance, training and support. The Director of Finance is also responsible for focusing on the profitability of the business, maintaining accurate and timely financial reporting, ensuring acceptable levels of internal controls, ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, and safeguarding owners/investors assets.

Responsibilities

Financial:

Acts as the “Chief Business Officer” to the general manager and EC Team, and as such is responsible for evaluating the financial impact on business decisions.
Ensure that all levels of management are promptly notified of any financial deviations from established policies and/or control weaknesses in the hotel.
Effectively manage and communicate cash flow related issues, as required to management and ownership. This includes the accurate and timely preparation of cash-flow statements, management of receivables, cash balances, control mechanisms and timely deposits of all funds.
Monitor hotel revenues and expenses and ensure the accurate recording in accordance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts established guidelines. Investigate and critique variances to budget or to prior year and offer practical improvement strategies to management.
Monitor the capital planning process by assisting management with calculation of return on capital improvements, gathering support and monitoring the bid process, and evaluating scope of work and specifications.
Ensure Hotels’ compliance on all regulatory licenses and permits, leases, contracts, legal agreements, and the proper execution of all operational taxes. Provide assistance to management in enforcing compliance on all these items.
Coordinate the completion of all forecasts and budgets as required, with the full and active participation of EC Team and department managers.
Analyze financial data and operations in order to assist and advise management in maintaining the Hotels’ financial objectives.
Ensure that all balance sheet accounts, including bank reconciliations are reconciled on a timely basis.
Establish and continually audit all internal financial controls including purchasing, cash handling, disbursements, credit extension, inventories, hotel assets, master keys, payroll, and employee records.
Embrace a continuous growth environment by actively hiring professional staff and assisting in recruiting, reviewing, recommending and maintaining an inventory of qualified and promotable Associates that can potentially become Directors of Finance, Assistant Directors of Finance, Accounting Managers, and other managers for the organization.
Continually focus on training and development programs for finance associates to cultivate the “brightest” and “best” talent within the industry.
Hire, train, supervise and develop staff, including coaching, counseling and discipline.
Maintain compliance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards and regulations to ensure safe and efficient operation of the hotel.
Ensure proper utilization, maintenance and periodic upgrades of all IT systems and equipments.
Direct and/or prepare all financial reports in accordance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts requirements meeting various due dates and deadlines:
Ensure and monitor that the hotel is in compliance with all report deadlines and due dates and react accordingly.
Maximize efforts towards productivity, identify problem areas and assist in finding and implementing their solutions.
Approach all encounters with guests and employees in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service-oriented manner.
Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards, as required by scheduling which will vary according to the needs of the hotel.
Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which include wearing the professional attire and nametag when working.
Comply at all times with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient hotel operations.

QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

Education & Experience

A minimum of 8 years of related progressive experience in hotel Accounting or related field; or a 4-year college degree with an Accounting/Finance concentration and a minimum of 4 years of related progressive experience; or a 2-year college degree and a minimum of 6 years of related progressive experience.
Must be fluent in both written and spoken English and French.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

jobs.title: Director, Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
At Viral Nation,
we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

The Director, Business Intelligence will lead enterprise-wide analytics strategy and will be responsible for building and leading a high-performing team of analysts delivering actionable insights across sales forecasting, retail performance, campaign measurement, and influencer/paid/social strategy optimization.

This leader will serve as a strategic thought partner to Sales, Marketing, Brand, eCommerce, Finance, and Executive Leadership, translating data into commercial growth opportunities, driving ROI, and embedding analytics into core business decision-making. The role combines strategic vision, technical depth, cross-functional leadership, and team development.

Responsibilities:

Act as a senior analytics partner to client account, strategy, and service teams by translating client objectives into scalable, best-in-class measurement frameworks that support social-first marketing performance.
Serve as the senior analytics advisor to executive leadership, shaping marketing, retail, and social investment decisions through data-driven insights.
Elevate analytics from reporting to strategic advantage by synthesizing data into clear narratives that inform brand positioning, channel strategy, and enterprise decision-making.
Own end-to-end measurement strategy across paid media, influencer, social, and retail media, ensuring clear linkage between investment and revenue outcomes.
Forecast and quantify incremental revenue and retail lift across eCommerce and offline retail partners by developing predictive models that connect media spend, influencer engagement, and social performance to sales velocity and conversion.
Design and operationalize robust ROI frameworks, including brand lift studies, sales lift studies, incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, and marketing mix modeling, translating insights into optimized channel mix and budget allocation.
Build scalable measurement systems to evaluate influencer effectiveness, content performance, audience growth, and conversion impact, informing creative strategy and platform optimization.
Identify emerging consumer and digital engagement trends to inform brand strategy, innovation, and go-to-market planning.
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing analytics team, fostering a culture of analytical rigor, commercial acumen, and executive-ready storytelling.
Design and oversee scalable data collection and reporting infrastructure, including structured databases, automated reporting workflows, dashboards, and standardized presentations.

Qualifications:

Extensive experience in marketing, media, or agency environments, with demonstrated ability to apply analytics and research to drive client strategy and business outcomes.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (Social Sciences, Statistics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related discipline), or equivalent practical experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in research, analytics, and measurement, with a proven track record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives.
Advanced expertise in primary and secondary research methodologies, including brand tracking, brand and communications strategy, brand lift studies, regression analysis, Market Mix Modeling, social listening, and digital and site analytics.
Deep technical proficiency in analytics and BI technologies, including Python and SQL for analysis and data modeling, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and Snowflake for data infrastructure, and BI tools such as Sigma or comparable platforms for scalable reporting and dashboarding.
Demonstrated ability to architect and optimize analytics workflows, data pipelines, and reporting systems that support automation, scalability, and self-serve insights.
Strong executive-level communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior client stakeholders, providing strategic guidance grounded in data, research rigor, and business context.

This role has an annual salary range of $140,000 - $160,000.

This range reflects the full scope and progression of the role, from building capability to operating with sustained impact at a higher level. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits and total rewards package designed to support our team as they grow with us.

Where an offer falls within this range is determined through the interview process. Candidates are benchmarked by the hiring team based on role scope, relevant experience, skill alignment, and expected impact, using consistent and objective criteria.

Compensation Philosophy:

At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.

Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.

AI in Recruitment:

Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

DEI Commitment:

Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

jobs.title: Director, Payroll Transformation
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 264681

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director, Payroll Transformation leads the design, implementation, and modernization of enterprise payroll systems and processes across the organization. This role is accountable for delivering large-scale payroll transformation initiatives, with a focus on SAP HCM and/or SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, ensuring system accuracy, operational continuity, and alignment across Human Resources, Technology, and Finance.

As a key leader within the transformation program, this role provides oversight and direction across all phases of payroll system delivery, including design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization. The Director will ensure payroll solutions are scalable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards, while supporting a seamless employee experience.

A core aspect of this role is to partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to align business requirements with system capabilities, manage complex integrations across HRIS, finance, time, and third-party platforms, and ensure the successful execution of payroll transformation objectives.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

Lead end-to-end payroll transformation initiatives, including solution design, system configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization activities.
Drive payroll testing and validation efforts, including user acceptance testing (UAT), parallel payroll runs, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure system accuracy and readiness.
Oversee system integration across HR, Finance, time, and third-party platforms to enable seamless data flow and end-to-end payroll processing.
Partner with HR, Technology, Finance, and external vendors to align system requirements, manage dependencies, and deliver transformation outcomes.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and governance requirements related to payroll processing, data integrity, and financial reporting.
Lead cross-functional workstreams and collaborate with program stakeholders to ensure delivery against timelines, scope, and quality expectations.
Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to enhance payroll processes, systems, and overall operational efficiency.
Build and maintain strong relationships across stakeholders, fostering alignment, accountability, and effective communication throughout the transformation lifecycle.
Create an environment that promotes effective and efficient operations, ensuring alignment with Scotiabank’s Values and Code of Conduct, and supporting strong governance and control practices.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed? We’d love to work with you if you have:

Post-secondary education in Human Resources, Business, Technology, or a related field; relevant SAP or payroll certifications are considered an asset.
Progressive experience in payroll transformation, HR technology implementation, or enterprise system delivery within complex, large-scale environments.
Strong understanding of SAP HCM Payroll and/or SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, including system configuration, testing methodologies, and payroll operations.
Demonstrated experience supporting end-to-end payroll implementation, including design, UAT, parallel runs, and post-go-live stabilization.
Experience working across HR, Technology, Finance, and vendor partners, with the ability to translate business requirements into system functionality.
Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight timelines.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders and cross-functional teams.

Position Description

We are seeking a Director, Consulting Expert (DCE) – Enterprise Data Warehouse & Data Platforms to provide senior technical, solutioning, and client facing leadership

The DCE will serve as a trusted advisor to the client while helping shape, win, govern, and successfully deliver complex enterprise data initiatives.

This is not a narrow technical specialist or delivery only position. The DCE combines deep enterprise data warehouse and modern data platform expertise with consulting acumen, architecture leadership, commercial awareness, and executive presence. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with senior client stakeholders, shaping and estimating solutions, leading architecture decisions, and engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineering teams.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Serve as a senior client facing advisor for enterprise data warehouse, data engineering, analytics, and data platform modernization initiatives within a complex telecommunications environment.
Translate business objectives and requirements into actionable data strategies, architectures, roadmaps, and solution options.
Lead end to end solution architecture, considering data, applications, integration, cloud, cybersecurity, operations, cost, scalability, and delivery trade offs.
Architect and guide enterprise data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including technologies such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Dataplex, Dataform, and Looker.
Provide technical leadership across enterprise data warehousing, data modelling, ETL/ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, data quality, metadata, governance, security, and analytics.
Lead or co lead technical solutioning for strategic pursuits, proposals, RFPs, and account growth opportunities.
Develop and challenge solution scope, architecture, assumptions, estimates, resource models, dependencies, risks, and delivery approaches to ensure solutions are competitive and executable.
Orchestrate SMEs across data, cloud, applications, integration, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations to develop cohesive end to end solutions.
Lead or participate in architecture, estimation, proposal, and delivery governance reviews, identifying technical and delivery risks before commitments are made.
Advise on AI/ML and generative AI data readiness, including data quality, accessibility, governance, privacy, security, and responsible adoption.
Maintain sufficient hands on technical depth to challenge designs, validate assumptions, troubleshoot critical issues, and defend architectural decisions.
Mentor architects and technical leads and promote reusable architectures, patterns, accelerators, and solution assets across the team.
Partner with the DCS and broader P&L leadership to strengthen the client relationship, identify growth opportunities, improve solution quality, and develop technical leadership capability within the team.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

10+ years of progressively responsible experience in leading enterprise data warehousing, data engineering, analytics, cloud architecture, solution architecture, or related IT consulting disciplines.
Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering complex enterprise data warehouse and modern cloud data platform solutions.
Strong experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its data and analytics ecosystem, particularly Big Query and associated ingestion, processing, orchestration, governance, and analytics capabilities.
Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data modelling, ETL/ELT, data integration, data quality, metadata, security, governance, and analytics.
Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of modern data engineering technologies and practices such as Python, Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, APIs, and automated testing/deployment.
Experience with enterprise data technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Oracle, SQL Server, Teradata, Informatica, DataStage, dbt, or comparable platforms.
Demonstrated experience leading solution architecture for significant client engagements, proposals, RFPs, or complex technology pursuits.
Experience developing or validating solution estimates, delivery models, assumptions, dependencies, and technical risks.
Strong consulting and executive communication skills, including discovery, problem framing, facilitation, solution development, and client presentations.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary technical teams, influence senior stakeholders, and mentor architects and technical leaders.
Working knowledge of AI/ML and generative AI concepts and their implications for enterprise data architecture and governance.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience delivering data and analytics solutions within the telecommunications industry, with an understanding of large scale, high volume telco data environments and associated business and operational use cases.
Google Cloud certification, particularly Professional Cloud Architect and/or Professional Data Engineer, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
Experience modernizing large legacy or on premises enterprise data warehouse environments to GCP.
Experience within a large IT consulting, systems integration, managed services, or professional services organization.
Experience supporting large, complex and highly integrated enterprise technology environments.
Commercial awareness encompassing consulting economics, solution costing, delivery risk, and value based solutioning.

Leadership Profile

The successful DCE will be a visible, take charge consulting leader who:

Leads with client and business outcomes rather than technology alone.
Has the executive presence to independently lead senior client conversations.
Takes ownership of ambiguous or difficult solution problems and drives them to resolution.
Retains enough hands on technical depth to challenge and defend important architecture decisions.
Challenges unrealistic estimates, unsupported assumptions, scope gaps, and delivery risks before commitments are made.
Works across organizational and technology boundaries rather than operating as a narrow or isolated SME.
Coaches and develops architects and technical leaders, raising the capability of the broader team.

Measures of Success

Success will be reflected in stronger client relationships, higher quality solutions and estimates, improved pursuit outcomes, reduced delivery risk, successful enterprise data initiatives, and increased technical capability across the team.

The DCE will be recognized by the client, delivery teams, DCS, and broader P&L leadership as a trusted senior advisor who connects telecommunications business outcomes, enterprise data architecture, technology, commercial realities, and delivery feasibility.

jobs.title: Chief Technology and Information Officer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

POSITION PURPOSE SUMMARY

The Chief Technology and Information Officer (CTIO) provides enterprise leadership and strategic direction for technology, information systems, data, cybersecurity and digital capabilities across The Salvation Army Canada and Bermuda Territory.

As a senior organizational leader, the CTIO ensures technology strategy and investment support The Salvation Army’s mission, strategic priorities and operational needs. The role is accountable for technology, cybersecurity and resilience, enterprise systems, data and digital capability, technology operations, vendor partnerships, financial stewardship and the ongoing development of a high-performing technology function.

Working across a large, geographically dispersed and decentralized organization, the CTIO builds trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders, balances enterprise consistency with operational realities, and drives technology adoption and organizational efficiencies in a way that reflects The Salvation Army’s mission, values and culture.

ACCOUNTABILITIES

Mission, Culture and Organizational Leadership

Authentically lead in alignment with The Salvation Army’s mission, vision, values, Christian identity and spiritual foundations, recognizing that its social and community services are expressions of its higher purpose to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in communities.
Ensure technology strategy, investment and decision-making ultimately enable people, ministry and services to advance the mission.
Contribute as an enterprise leader to organizational strategy, priorities and decisions beyond the technology portfolio.
Balance enterprise standards and priorities with legitimate operational, geographic and ministry-specific needs.

Executive and People Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing technology leadership team with clear accountability, a service-oriented culture, strong succession and workforce planning, and the appropriate balance of internal and external capability.
Provide strategic advice to senior leadership, translating complex technology, cybersecurity, data and digital issues into clear organizational choices, risks, opportunities and investment decisions.
Lead significant organizational change associated with technology transformation, recognizing that successful adoption depends on people, process, culture and technology.
Build strong relationships with operational leaders and users to understand needs and continuously improve technology effectiveness.
Model strong stewardship, integrity and accountability in leadership and decision-making.

Enterprise Technology Strategy

Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy aligned with organizational priorities and mission.
Stabilize and simplify the technology environment, strengthening reliability, integration, interoperability and sustainable adoption.
Optimize existing technology platforms and investments before introducing new solutions.
Improve connectivity and interoperability between systems to create a more seamless technology and user environment.
Establish technology roadmaps, portfolio governance and prioritization that sequence investments appropriately and balance innovation, affordability, risk, organizational readiness and capacity.
Lead targeted modernization and transformation where it creates clear organizational value, while assessing emerging technologies thoughtfully.
Oversee the technology project and investment portfolio, ensuring appropriate governance, stakeholder engagement and benefits realization.

Cybersecurity, Data and Technology Risk

Provide executive oversight of cybersecurity, information security, privacy, technology risk and resilience.
Ensure appropriate controls, governance and compliance are in place to protect organizational information, systems and technology assets.
Maintain effective disaster recovery, business continuity and technology resilience capabilities.
Ensure security, privacy, data protection and risk considerations are embedded in technology investments, vendor relationships and emerging technology adoption.

Technology Operations and Service Delivery

Ensure reliable, secure, responsive and cost-effective delivery of enterprise applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud services, end-user technology and service management.
Establish service standards, performance measures and continuous improvement practices that strengthen user experience and technology effectiveness.
Maintain an enterprise technology architecture that supports integration, scalability, security and future organizational requirements.

Financial, Vendor and Investment Stewardship – Money, Sourcing and Commercial Discipline

Lead technology operating and capital budgets and multi-year investment planning, ensuring investments demonstrate strategic value, affordability and sustainability.
Oversee business cases, cost-benefit analysis and benefits realization for significant technology investments.
Establish effective sourcing strategies and lead strategic vendor relationships, contract performance and commercial negotiations.
Drive cost effectiveness through technology simplification, optimization, disciplined sourcing and effective management of technology assets and services.

Strategic Business Enablement, Data and Artificial Intelligence

Connect technology, data and digital priorities directly to organizational strategy, mission outcomes, service delivery and measurable value.
Act as an enterprise integrator across ministries, functions and geographies, using technology and data to simplify processes, strengthen service delivery and improve decision-making.
Lead enterprise data strategy, governance, stewardship, quality, analytics and reporting to enable trusted and actionable information.
Establish and oversee responsible AI and automation governance, ensuring use cases are mission-aligned, secure, ethical, legally compliant, operationally practical and supported by appropriate human oversight.
Establish governance and performance measures that allow senior leaders to monitor technology value, data maturity, digital adoption and AI readiness.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

Mission and Organizational Alignment

Demonstrated alignment with and ability to authentically lead within The Salvation Army’s mission, values and Christian foundations.
Demonstrated understanding that The Salvation Army’s social and community services are expressions of a broader mission to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in communities.
Ability to operate effectively within a large, complex, values-based and decentralized organization.
Demonstrated commitment to ethical leadership, stewardship, collaboration and service.

Education and Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Engineering or a related discipline is required.
Master’s degree in Business Administration, Technology, Information Systems or a related field may be considered an asset.
Relevant executive technology, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, governance or program management certifications may be an asset.
An equivalent combination of education and significant relevant executive experience may be considered.

Experience and Knowledge

Significant progressive leadership experience in technology, information systems, digital or related discipline, including substantial senior executive or enterprise leadership experience.
Demonstrated success developing and executing enterprise technology strategies and leading transformation or modernization.
Experience leading technology within a large, complex, multi-site and/or geographically dispersed organization.
Broad executive-level understanding of enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, data, integration, digital capability and technology operations.
Demonstrated experience overseeing cybersecurity, technology risk, resilience and business continuity.
Experience with enterprise data governance, analytics and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.
Significant experience managing technology budgets, investment decisions, strategic vendors and major contracts.
Proven success in building and developing high-performing leadership teams.
Demonstrated experience leading complex organizational change and influencing senior stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience advising executive leadership and governance bodies on technology strategy, investment, cybersecurity, risk and organizational implications.
Experience in a decentralized, faith-based, not-for-profit, healthcare, public sector or similarly complex service organization is considered an asset.
Demonstrated experience establishing or maturing enterprise data strategies, data governance, analytics capability and information management practices across a complex organization.
Experience reviewing, governing and deploying artificial intelligence or advanced automation capabilities with appropriate attention to ethics, privacy, cybersecurity, risk, adoption, benefits realization and operational readiness.

SKILLS AND LEADERSHIP CAPABILITIES

Strategic enterprise thinker who connects technology, data and digital priorities to organizational strategy and mission outcomes.
Strong executive judgment with the ability to prioritize competing demands and balance innovation, risk, cost, organizational capacity and readiness.
Proven people leader who builds organizational capability, develops senior leaders and creates clarity and accountability.
Exceptional relationship builder and influencer who can navigate a decentralized, relationship-driven organization while advancing enterprise priorities.
Clear and compelling communicator who translates complex technology issues into understandable organizational implications and decisions for technical and non-technical audiences.
Proven people leader who builds organizational capability, develops senior leaders and creates clarity and accountability.
Strong business, financial and commercial acumen, including technology investment, vendor management and benefits realization.
Data-driven and digitally fluent executive who can establish trusted information, enable analytics and guide responsible AI and automation adoption with appropriate governance and human oversight.
Values-based leader who demonstrates integrity, humility, stewardship and a strong service orientation.
Comfortable with complexity and ambiguity, with the ability to bring clarity, structure and direction to challenging organizational situations.

Compensation:

The target hiring range for this position is $244,046.40 to $305,052.80 with a maximum of $366,059.20. Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

The Director, Business Intelligence will lead enterprise-wide analytics strategy and will be responsible for building and leading a high-performing team of analysts delivering actionable insights across sales forecasting, retail performance, campaign measurement, and influencer/paid/social strategy optimization.

This leader will serve as a strategic thought partner to Sales, Marketing, Brand, eCommerce, Finance, and Executive Leadership, translating data into commercial growth opportunities, driving ROI, and embedding analytics into core business decision-making. The role combines strategic vision, technical depth, cross-functional leadership, and team development.

Responsibilities:

Act as a senior analytics partner to client account, strategy, and service teams by translating client objectives into scalable, best-in-class measurement frameworks that support social-first marketing performance.
Serve as the senior analytics advisor to executive leadership, shaping marketing, retail, and social investment decisions through data-driven insights.
Elevate analytics from reporting to strategic advantage by synthesizing data into clear narratives that inform brand positioning, channel strategy, and enterprise decision-making.
Own end-to-end measurement strategy across paid media, influencer, social, and retail media, ensuring clear linkage between investment and revenue outcomes.
Forecast and quantify incremental revenue and retail lift across eCommerce and offline retail partners by developing predictive models that connect media spend, influencer engagement, and social performance to sales velocity and conversion.
Design and operationalize robust ROI frameworks, including brand lift studies, sales lift studies, incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, and marketing mix modeling, translating insights into optimized channel mix and budget allocation.
Build scalable measurement systems to evaluate influencer effectiveness, content performance, audience growth, and conversion impact, informing creative strategy and platform optimization.
Identify emerging consumer and digital engagement trends to inform brand strategy, innovation, and go-to-market planning.
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing analytics team, fostering a culture of analytical rigor, commercial acumen, and executive-ready storytelling.
Design and oversee scalable data collection and reporting infrastructure, including structured databases, automated reporting workflows, dashboards, and standardized presentations.

Qualifications:

Extensive experience in marketing, media, or agency environments, with demonstrated ability to apply analytics and research to drive client strategy and business outcomes.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (Social Sciences, Statistics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related discipline), or equivalent practical experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in research, analytics, and measurement, with a proven track record of leading complex, high-impact initiatives.
Advanced expertise in primary and secondary research methodologies, including brand tracking, brand and communications strategy, brand lift studies, regression analysis, Market Mix Modeling, social listening, and digital and site analytics.
Deep technical proficiency in analytics and BI technologies, including Python and SQL for analysis and data modeling, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, and Snowflake for data infrastructure, and BI tools such as Sigma or comparable platforms for scalable reporting and dashboarding.
Demonstrated ability to architect and optimize analytics workflows, data pipelines, and reporting systems that support automation, scalability, and self-serve insights.
Strong executive-level communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior client stakeholders, providing strategic guidance grounded in data, research rigor, and business context.

This role has an annual salary range of $140,000 - $160,000.

This range reflects the full scope and progression of the role, from building capability to operating with sustained impact at a higher level. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits and total rewards package designed to support our team as they grow with us.

Where an offer falls within this range is determined through the interview process. Candidates are benchmarked by the hiring team based on role scope, relevant experience, skill alignment, and expected impact, using consistent and objective criteria.

Compensation Philosophy:

At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.

Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.

AI in Recruitment:

new_jobs.title: Director, Payroll Transformation
new_jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 264681

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director, Payroll Transformation leads the design, implementation, and modernization of enterprise payroll systems and processes across the organization. This role is accountable for delivering large-scale payroll transformation initiatives, with a focus on SAP HCM and/or SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, ensuring system accuracy, operational continuity, and alignment across Human Resources, Technology, and Finance.

As a key leader within the transformation program, this role provides oversight and direction across all phases of payroll system delivery, including design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization. The Director will ensure payroll solutions are scalable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards, while supporting a seamless employee experience.

A core aspect of this role is to partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to align business requirements with system capabilities, manage complex integrations across HRIS, finance, time, and third-party platforms, and ensure the successful execution of payroll transformation objectives.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

Lead end-to-end payroll transformation initiatives, including solution design, system configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization activities.
Drive payroll testing and validation efforts, including user acceptance testing (UAT), parallel payroll runs, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure system accuracy and readiness.
Oversee system integration across HR, Finance, time, and third-party platforms to enable seamless data flow and end-to-end payroll processing.
Partner with HR, Technology, Finance, and external vendors to align system requirements, manage dependencies, and deliver transformation outcomes.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and governance requirements related to payroll processing, data integrity, and financial reporting.
Lead cross-functional workstreams and collaborate with program stakeholders to ensure delivery against timelines, scope, and quality expectations.
Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to enhance payroll processes, systems, and overall operational efficiency.
Build and maintain strong relationships across stakeholders, fostering alignment, accountability, and effective communication throughout the transformation lifecycle.
Create an environment that promotes effective and efficient operations, ensuring alignment with Scotiabank’s Values and Code of Conduct, and supporting strong governance and control practices.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed? We’d love to work with you if you have:

Post-secondary education in Human Resources, Business, Technology, or a related field; relevant SAP or payroll certifications are considered an asset.
Progressive experience in payroll transformation, HR technology implementation, or enterprise system delivery within complex, large-scale environments.
Strong understanding of SAP HCM Payroll and/or SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, including system configuration, testing methodologies, and payroll operations.
Demonstrated experience supporting end-to-end payroll implementation, including design, UAT, parallel runs, and post-go-live stabilization.
Experience working across HR, Technology, Finance, and vendor partners, with the ability to translate business requirements into system functionality.
Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight timelines.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
High attention to detail and a strong focus on accuracy, data integrity, and risk mitigation within payroll environments.
Ability to operate effectively within regulated environments, with familiarity in governance, compliance, and audit standards.
Strong leadership capability with a focus on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

new_jobs.title: Chief Technology and Information Officer
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

POSITION PURPOSE SUMMARY

The Chief Technology and Information Officer (CTIO) provides enterprise leadership and strategic direction for technology, information systems, data, cybersecurity and digital capabilities across The Salvation Army Canada and Bermuda Territory.

As a senior organizational leader, the CTIO ensures technology strategy and investment support The Salvation Army’s mission, strategic priorities and operational needs. The role is accountable for technology, cybersecurity and resilience, enterprise systems, data and digital capability, technology operations, vendor partnerships, financial stewardship and the ongoing development of a high-performing technology function.

Working across a large, geographically dispersed and decentralized organization, the CTIO builds trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders, balances enterprise consistency with operational realities, and drives technology adoption and organizational efficiencies in a way that reflects The Salvation Army’s mission, values and culture.

ACCOUNTABILITIES

Mission, Culture and Organizational Leadership

Authentically lead in alignment with The Salvation Army’s mission, vision, values, Christian identity and spiritual foundations, recognizing that its social and community services are expressions of its higher purpose to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in communities.
Ensure technology strategy, investment and decision-making ultimately enable people, ministry and services to advance the mission.
Contribute as an enterprise leader to organizational strategy, priorities and decisions beyond the technology portfolio.
Balance enterprise standards and priorities with legitimate operational, geographic and ministry-specific needs.

Executive and People Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing technology leadership team with clear accountability, a service-oriented culture, strong succession and workforce planning, and the appropriate balance of internal and external capability.
Provide strategic advice to senior leadership, translating complex technology, cybersecurity, data and digital issues into clear organizational choices, risks, opportunities and investment decisions.
Lead significant organizational change associated with technology transformation, recognizing that successful adoption depends on people, process, culture and technology.
Build strong relationships with operational leaders and users to understand needs and continuously improve technology effectiveness.
Model strong stewardship, integrity and accountability in leadership and decision-making.

Enterprise Technology Strategy

Develop and execute a multi-year enterprise technology strategy aligned with organizational priorities and mission.
Stabilize and simplify the technology environment, strengthening reliability, integration, interoperability and sustainable adoption.
Optimize existing technology platforms and investments before introducing new solutions.
Improve connectivity and interoperability between systems to create a more seamless technology and user environment.
Establish technology roadmaps, portfolio governance and prioritization that sequence investments appropriately and balance innovation, affordability, risk, organizational readiness and capacity.
Lead targeted modernization and transformation where it creates clear organizational value, while assessing emerging technologies thoughtfully.
Oversee the technology project and investment portfolio, ensuring appropriate governance, stakeholder engagement and benefits realization.

Cybersecurity, Data and Technology Risk

Provide executive oversight of cybersecurity, information security, privacy, technology risk and resilience.
Ensure appropriate controls, governance and compliance are in place to protect organizational information, systems and technology assets.
Maintain effective disaster recovery, business continuity and technology resilience capabilities.
Ensure security, privacy, data protection and risk considerations are embedded in technology investments, vendor relationships and emerging technology adoption.

Technology Operations and Service Delivery

Ensure reliable, secure, responsive and cost-effective delivery of enterprise applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud services, end-user technology and service management.
Establish service standards, performance measures and continuous improvement practices that strengthen user experience and technology effectiveness.
Maintain an enterprise technology architecture that supports integration, scalability, security and future organizational requirements.

Financial, Vendor and Investment Stewardship – Money, Sourcing and Commercial Discipline

Lead technology operating and capital budgets and multi-year investment planning, ensuring investments demonstrate strategic value, affordability and sustainability.
Oversee business cases, cost-benefit analysis and benefits realization for significant technology investments.
Establish effective sourcing strategies and lead strategic vendor relationships, contract performance and commercial negotiations.
Drive cost effectiveness through technology simplification, optimization, disciplined sourcing and effective management of technology assets and services.

Strategic Business Enablement, Data and Artificial Intelligence

Connect technology, data and digital priorities directly to organizational strategy, mission outcomes, service delivery and measurable value.
Act as an enterprise integrator across ministries, functions and geographies, using technology and data to simplify processes, strengthen service delivery and improve decision-making.
Lead enterprise data strategy, governance, stewardship, quality, analytics and reporting to enable trusted and actionable information.
Establish and oversee responsible AI and automation governance, ensuring use cases are mission-aligned, secure, ethical, legally compliant, operationally practical and supported by appropriate human oversight.
Establish governance and performance measures that allow senior leaders to monitor technology value, data maturity, digital adoption and AI readiness.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

Mission and Organizational Alignment

Demonstrated alignment with and ability to authentically lead within The Salvation Army’s mission, values and Christian foundations.
Demonstrated understanding that The Salvation Army’s social and community services are expressions of a broader mission to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in communities.
Ability to operate effectively within a large, complex, values-based and decentralized organization.
Demonstrated commitment to ethical leadership, stewardship, collaboration and service.

Education and Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Engineering or a related discipline is required.
Master’s degree in Business Administration, Technology, Information Systems or a related field may be considered an asset.
Relevant executive technology, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, governance or program management certifications may be an asset.
An equivalent combination of education and significant relevant executive experience may be considered.

Experience and Knowledge

Significant progressive leadership experience in technology, information systems, digital or related discipline, including substantial senior executive or enterprise leadership experience.
Demonstrated success developing and executing enterprise technology strategies and leading transformation or modernization.
Experience leading technology within a large, complex, multi-site and/or geographically dispersed organization.
Broad executive-level understanding of enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, data, integration, digital capability and technology operations.
Demonstrated experience overseeing cybersecurity, technology risk, resilience and business continuity.
Experience with enterprise data governance, analytics and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.
Significant experience managing technology budgets, investment decisions, strategic vendors and major contracts.
Proven success in building and developing high-performing leadership teams.
Demonstrated experience leading complex organizational change and influencing senior stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience advising executive leadership and governance bodies on technology strategy, investment, cybersecurity, risk and organizational implications.
Experience in a decentralized, faith-based, not-for-profit, healthcare, public sector or similarly complex service organization is considered an asset.
Demonstrated experience establishing or maturing enterprise data strategies, data governance, analytics capability and information management practices across a complex organization.
Experience reviewing, governing and deploying artificial intelligence or advanced automation capabilities with appropriate attention to ethics, privacy, cybersecurity, risk, adoption, benefits realization and operational readiness.

SKILLS AND LEADERSHIP CAPABILITIES

Strategic enterprise thinker who connects technology, data and digital priorities to organizational strategy and mission outcomes.
Strong executive judgment with the ability to prioritize competing demands and balance innovation, risk, cost, organizational capacity and readiness.
Proven people leader who builds organizational capability, develops senior leaders and creates clarity and accountability.
Exceptional relationship builder and influencer who can navigate a decentralized, relationship-driven organization while advancing enterprise priorities.
Clear and compelling communicator who translates complex technology issues into understandable organizational implications and decisions for technical and non-technical audiences.
Proven people leader who builds organizational capability, develops senior leaders and creates clarity and accountability.
Strong business, financial and commercial acumen, including technology investment, vendor management and benefits realization.
Data-driven and digitally fluent executive who can establish trusted information, enable analytics and guide responsible AI and automation adoption with appropriate governance and human oversight.
Values-based leader who demonstrates integrity, humility, stewardship and a strong service orientation.
Comfortable with complexity and ambiguity, with the ability to bring clarity, structure and direction to challenging organizational situations.

Compensation:

The target hiring range for this position is $244,046.40 to $305,052.80 with a maximum of $366,059.20. Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.
